title: さしすせそ・せせらぎ の みち
jp: さ行 ・ gojuon row 3 ・ nature

render.trackName: せせらぎ の みち

blurb: Row 3 of the gojuon — さ し す せ そ — through the outdoors and the seasons: cherry blossoms on a slope, an island in the sea, white sand and violets, a mountain brook and a summer cicada, the blue sky and a spring breeze. The calm nature variation of three さ-row songs.
concept: Words alone blend (findings F-10), so every target sits in a small image — さくら の はな, やま の せせらぎ, あおい そら — and it recombines with earlier rows (あめ, あき, うみ, あおい, かぜ, はる return), keeping the ladder (F-13).
The five-kana row さ し す せ そ closes every verse as the sung-together refrain (F-07). The 3-minute cut adds a seasons-walk bridge and a sentences-only review, not a loop (F-12).

This is the nature variation — the calm one, for a koto × modern arrangement. さ行 has the poetic nature words (さくら, せせらぎ, そよかぜ) that suit it best, and it carries the hard せ row gracefully (a mountain brook, a summer cicada, a wide vista).
